contentList.content: Raphael
Infernal Heritage

Raphael keeps a sliver of his true nature: Igniting Spark, Flames of Avernus, Infernal Guise, Resistance to Fire damage and proficiency with Heavy Armour. Flames of Avernus uses an Infernal Charge, regained on a Long Rest.
Infernal Charge
Fuels Raphael's Flames of Avernus. Regained on a Long Rest, or by Soul Reaper.
Soul Reaper
Once per Short Rest, when Raphael lands the killing blow on an enemy, he severs its soul and regains his Infernal Charge for Flames of Avernus.
Inevitable Resolve
Once per Short Rest, in combat: when Raphael is Held, Dominated, Incapacitated, Restrained, Turned, Planar Bound or forced to dance, the effect ends after 1 turn.
Fiendish Blessing
Raphael's infernal nature grants him +2 Armour Class.
Launch a mote of infernal flame at a target. On a hit it deals Fire damage that grows with your level, and sets the target Burning.
Loose a searing wave of infernal fire from your palms. Uses an Infernal Charge (regained on a Long Rest).

Raphael steps out of the shadows beside the portal.

"Leaving so soon? You walked my halls, you gazed upon our contract, and you left it whole. How refreshingly... honest.

The road to the Crown runs through dangerous country. Perhaps I should see our investment protected personally."

Yes: "OK Raphael, if you are so nervous about it, why don't you join us, so long as you help and don't just make snarky jokes."

No: "Raphael, I think I would feel safer with you looking over us from Avernus. But I look forward to seeing you again."

Raphael steps out of the smoke, holding up a hand to still his servants.

"You have something that belongs to my Archive. Return it, and this unpleasantness is forgotten. Keep it... and our contract permits me a great many things."

Yes: "Well, Raphael, since you asked so nicely, here you go."

No: "Raphael, I have had enough of your bossing. You stole the item, and now I stole it from you. Seems fair to me."

"Think very carefully."

Yes: "I have thought about it. It stays with me."

No: "Fine, fine. Take your trinket back, before you sulk."

(Keeping it means Raphael will not let you leave: you will have to fight him, or yield your soul.)

Raphael's smile does not reach his eyes.

"Gone? Then there is nothing left to return but what the contract promises me."

The treasure returns to its place.

"There. Was that so hard? Consider the matter closed.
Now - the road to the Crown is long, and you are clearly in need of supervision."

Yes: "I don't need your supervision, Raphael, but if you are willing to help and not just make snarky jokes, then by all means join us."

No: "The last thing I need is supervision by a sarcastic devil. I think we are better off using our own best judgment."

"You rummaged where you should not have, but nothing of mine left the room. I shall be generous.
The road to the Crown is long, and you are clearly in need of supervision."

Yes: "Generous? From you? Fine, Raphael, join us, but help, and keep the snarky jokes to a minimum."

No: "Thank you for your generosity, Raphael, but we will manage just fine without supervision from a sarcastic devil."

"As you wish. Our contract stands. Do try not to die before you deliver."
Raphael vanishes.

"As you wish. The debt is settled - this time."
Raphael vanishes.
Raphael has joined your party.
Your party is full. Raphael will wait for you in camp.
Finish the fight before you leave the House of Hope.

Raphael's form flickers with hellfire.

"You break faith with ME? Then our association is at an end."
Raphael has left the party.
Raphael has left your company for good.

Raphael adjusts his cuffs.

"Our business together is nearly concluded. I shall await my prize where it will be delivered. Do not keep me waiting."
Raphael has left the party.

Raphael watches the Astral Plane with open hunger.

"This is where I leave you. I have business to attend to before the end."
Raphael has left the party for good. His belongings were handed to you.

"Are you quite certain? Offers from me are... rarely repeated. And no one refuses me and simply walks out of my House."

Yes: "Well, on second thought, only because you are such a handsome devil, OK."

No: "Well, on second thought... the answer is still No. I don't feel that you would be a good fit for our team."

(If you still refuse, he will not let you leave in peace.)

Raphael steps out beside the portal, and the air still smells of Hope's broken chains.

"You set my little prisoner free. Our contract gives me every right to your soul for that, here and now. And yet... one soul is such a small thing beside a crown. Let her keep her freedom, and her House. You shall have me instead."

Yes: "Hope keeps her freedom and her House, and you keep your snarky jokes to yourself. Then we have a deal. Join us."

No: "Hope is free, and so are we. We will manage without you, Raphael."

(Hope stays behind in the House.)

Raphael's smile thins into something far older.

"Then we come to the part of our contract you only skimmed."

Yes: "Then let's skip the fine print. Come and take it, devil." (The battle for the House of Hope begins.)

No: "...Fine. Take what you are owed." (Yield your soul; you will be asked to confirm.)

"Wise. It hurts so much less this way."

Yes: "Get it over with." (This ends the game.)

No: "Not yet. Let me choose again." (Back to the choice.)

Raphael
Infernal Guise
Change Raphael's appearance. His abilities, statistics and equipment stay exactly as they are.
Wardrobe
Raphael appears as he is dressed: in his own suit, or in whatever armour and clothing you give him.
Signature Look
Raphael takes on his signature appearance, immaculate suit and all. His equipment still works but is not shown.
Devil Form
Raphael reveals his true infernal form. His equipment still works but is not shown.
Fiendish Ascension
Only in combat. Raphael becomes the Ascended Fiend until the fight ends. This form never appears in dialogues or cutscenes. Appearance only: his abilities do not change.
Fiendish Ascension (Towering Devil)
Only in combat. Raphael's devil form at twice its size, until the fight ends. Appearance only.
Wardrobe Look
Raphael appears as he is dressed.
Signature Look
Raphael wears his signature appearance. Equipment is not shown.
Devil Form
Raphael shows his true infernal form. Equipment is not shown.
Ascended Fiend
Raphael towers as the Ascended Fiend. Ends when combat ends.
Ascended Fiend (Towering Devil)
Raphael towers in devil form. Ends when combat ends.
Raphael's Suit
An impeccably tailored doublet and trousers. It offers no protection beyond excellent taste.
Raphael's Shoes
Polished leather, never scuffed, whatever the road.
Raphael's Suit (Camp Clothes)
The same immaculate suit, worn at camp and on special occasions.
Raphael's Shoes (Camp Clothes)
The same polished shoes, worn at camp.

Return what you took from my Archive.
Let me travel at your side until the Crown is within reach. Consider it an investment in our partnership.
Very well. Join us.
No. We'll manage without you.
Leave.
[Return the stolen items] Fine. Take them back.
No. You'll get nothing back from me.
Leave.
I'm sure. The answer is no.
On second thought - join us.
Leave.
There. All is forgiven - this once.
[Refuse] So be it. I'm keeping them.
Wait - take them back.
Let's talk.
You've been watching me all evening.
Join me.
Join me.
Wait for me at camp.
I want you gone. For good.
Leave.
Why are you really here, devil?
You want something from me. More than you've said.
Keep your claws where I can see them and we'll get along.
Talk straight or don't talk, hellspawn.
Admit it. I've handled all this rather deftly.
You never warn me about what's ahead.
What do I owe you for your help?
I don't like where this is going. But I'll see it through.
Why do you keep me so close, really?
Something else.
I'll leave you to it.
In what ways are you charmed, exactly?
Not tonight, devil.
Yes. Leave, and don't come back.
No. Stay.
Then name it.
Careful, devil. I might take you up on that.
You'd find me harder to charm than most.
And if I told you I was the one doing the charming?
Our association is ended. Don't expect me to come when you call.
Here? With the whole camp listening?
Lead the way.
It's been a pleasure, Raphael.
Goodbye, devil.
